fix(camellia): allow template main classification selection

Summary:
- keep image classification dialog changes in draft state until confirm
- allow confirming a selected main classification directly
- preserve vice classification override behavior when a leaf is chosen

Rationale:
- main classification selection previously cleared the saved classification
  and confirm only closed the dialog
- draft state keeps cancel behavior predictable while letting confirm apply
  the currently selected main or vice classification
